# Building a dashboard page

## Before you start

Read the closest existing page (the platform console pages are the cleanest), the UI kit
components it uses in `src/components/ui/`, and its tests. Pages here have **one job**; if
you are adding a fourth concern to a page, propose splitting it instead.

## Composition

```tsx
export function ThingPage() {
  const query = useQuery({ queryKey: ['thing', filters], queryFn: … });

  return (
    <AppLayout>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <PageHeader breadcrumb={[…]} title="…" description="…" actions={…} />
        {error && <Alert>{apiError(query.error)}</Alert>}
        {/* metric strip, then content, then states */}
      </div>
    </AppLayout>
  );
}
```

- States are part of the page: loading (`SkeletonCard`), empty (`EmptyState` — say what
  belongs here and how to fill it), error (`Alert` with `apiError`), and data.
- Use the kit, not raw markup: `Card`, `Chip`, `Badge`, `Button`, `Input`, `Select`,
  `Modal`, `Table`, `Avatar`, `PageHeader`, `EmptyState`, `Skeleton`.
- Style from the theme. Tokens live in `src/index.css`; never hardcode a hex.

## Queries

- Query keys are `['area', ...inputs]`. **Never include a `Date.now()`-derived value** —
  it changes every render and refetches forever. Derive time windows with `useMemo` keyed on
  the real input.
- Mutations invalidate the area key (`invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['requests'] })`) rather
  than refetching by hand.
- Surface failures with `apiError(error)` so validation messages reach the user verbatim.

## Guards

`requireAuth` → any signed-in user. `requireTenant` → additionally needs an active
household. `requirePlatformAdmin` → the landlord console. A platform admin has **no tenant**,
so anything tenant-scoped must be hidden behind `!is_platform_admin`; the shell does this for
the household switcher, status badge and Add Request.

## Accessibility floor

- Every control has an accessible name; icon-only buttons need `aria-label` or a visually
  hidden label.
- `aria-pressed` on toggles, `aria-expanded` on disclosure, `role="dialog"` +
  `aria-modal` on overlays (the `Modal` component already does this).
- Never colour alone — pair it with text or an icon.
- Focus rings stay visible; the global `:focus-visible` rule is deliberate.

## Testing traps (each of these has cost real time)

- **`tests/setup.ts` must not import stores or `@/lib/api`.** It runs before a test file's
  `vi.mock` applies, so the store caches live axios and the guard hits the network. Reset
  state with `tests/support/session.ts`.
- **Await anything from the API** (`await screen.findBy…`); headers render before
  react-query resolves.
- **Scope queries.** Filter `<option>` lists repeat table-row strings, and metric labels
  collide with column headings — use `within(...)`, or give the region an `aria-label`
  (the kanban summary strip uses `aria-label="Board summary"` for exactly this reason).
- **jsdom is pinned to 26**; v27 breaks Vitest's fork pool.

## Definition of done

`npm run build` clean, `npm test` green with a test in the matching layer, `npm run typecheck`
clean. Report the commands and their output.
